who_for: An ergonomic chair is worth it if you sit at a desk for several hours a day. Good adjustability helps you sit in a neutral position, which can reduce strain on your back, neck, and shoulders.
No chair fits everyone, so check the seat height range and weight capacity against your own height and build. Buy from a seller with a generous return window if you can.

how_we_picked.label: Adjustability
how_we_picked.text: We prioritized seat height and depth, armrest adjustment, and tilt tension so the chair can fit different body types.

how_we_picked.label: Lumbar support
how_we_picked.text: Adjustable lumbar support that follows the natural curve of your back mattered more than padding thickness.

how_we_picked.label: Build and materials
how_we_picked.text: We looked at frame materials, mesh versus foam seats, and owner reports on how the chair holds up after a year or more.

how_we_picked.label: Warranty
how_we_picked.text: Strong chairs often come with 10- to 12-year warranties. We treated short warranties on expensive chairs as a red flag.

how_we_picked.label: Price
how_we_picked.text: We compared what each tier adds, from budget mesh chairs to premium Steelcase models, so you know what extra money actually gets you.
